title: PostgreSQL Read Replicas and Replication Lag
realWorldScenario: A user updates their shipping address on an e-commerce site, clicks save, and is redirected to their profile page. The profile page still displays their old address. A refresh 2 seconds later shows the new address.
questionStatement: What is Replication Lag in primary-replica database architectures? What read-after-write consistency problem did this user experience, and how is it resolved?
hints: The write went to the Primary, but which server did the next read come from?
